name: Resource Action 1 Code
definition: Type of action to perform on a media resource.

PAUS.name: Pause
PAUS.definition: Pause the media resource in progress as specified in the message.

STAS.name: Play
STAS.definition: Start the media resource as specified in the message.

LOOP.name: Play In Loop
LOOP.definition: Play in a loop the media resource as specified in the message.

RESU.name: Resume
RESU.definition: Resume the progress of the media resource as specified in the message.

DVOL.name: Set Default Volume
DVOL.definition: Set the default volume of sounds.

STOS.name: Stop
STOS.definition: Stop the media resource in progress.
